title.zh: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody
title.en: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody

current_state.zh: Standard Chartered signed definitive agreements to acquire Zodia Custody's regulated operating entities across the UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, Luxembourg and the UAE, folding the crypto custodian into its Securities Services business pending regulatory approval.
current_state.en: Standard Chartered signed definitive agreements to acquire Zodia Custody's regulated operating entities across the UK, Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia, Luxembourg and the UAE, folding the crypto custodian into its Securities Services business pending regulatory approval.
